Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

street — a road with houses or shops. Example: Turn right at the second street.
near — close to. Example: The museum is near the station.
far — not near. Example: The airport is far from here.
city — a large town. Example: The museum is in the city centre.
town — a place smaller than a city. Example: I live in a small town.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Where is the ...?
• Go straight.
• Turn left at the corner.
• It is near the ...
• It is not far.

Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
The museum is in the city centre. Go straight and turn right at the second street. It is near the station, not far.
Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: Excuse me, where is the bank? B: Go straight and turn left at the corner. It is near the park. A: Is it far? B: No, five minutes.
